blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Web agents increasingly serve the same user across repeated online tasks such as booking travel, shopping, and scheduling, so their long-term usefulness depends on how well they know the user's preferences. Passive memory and personalization methods cannot obtain preferences the user never reveals, and clarification methods that value a question by its benefit to the current task overlook the benefit of reusing the answer in later tasks. We study Active Preference Acquisition (APA): which missing preferences are worth the cost of asking? We define the Prospective Personalization Value (PPV) of a missing preference as its expected cumulative utility gain over future tasks minus the effort and disclosure-risk cost of asking, and select questions under a per-interaction budget. We characterize when cumulative reuse justifies acquisition despite insufficient single-task benefit, and evaluate this regime with an initial-profile diagnostic. APA computes the counterfactual gain of each candidate preference on public task prototypes with the agent's own task solver and aggregates it by the expected reuse of each task family. We evaluate it on ActiveWebPref, a controlled longitudinal benchmark with hidden but queryable user profiles and exact task utilities. At a horizon of 20 tasks, 34.4% of budget-feasible valuable missing preferences are amortization-dependent; APA acquires 80.3% of them, whereas current-task value of information acquires 5.1%. Under per-user asking-cost caps matched to APA's realized expenditure, APA achieves higher net utility than four heuristic selection baselines. In our cost setting, asking about every unknown preference yields lower net utility than not asking, while APA recovers 84.2% of its utility gain with 27.6% of its questions. The value of acquiring a user preference should account for its reuse across future tasks, not only its benefit to the task at hand.
blocks.zh: 网络代理越来越多地为同一用户服务,完成多次在线任务,如预订旅行、购物和日程安排,因此其长期效用取决于他们对用户喜好的了解程度。 被动的内存和个人化方法不能获得用户从未透露的偏好,而通过对当前任务的好处来重视一个问题的澄清方法忽略了在后期任务中使用答案的好处. 我们研究Active Presidents Agreement(APA):哪些缺失的优惠值得要求的代价? 我们把缺失的偏好的前景个性化价值定义为:它对未来任务的预期累积效用增益减去询问的努力和披露风险成本,并在每次互动预算下选择问题。 我们说明,尽管单项任务的好处不足,但何时累积再利用才有理由获取,并以初步的诊断方法评估这一制度。 APA用代理商自己的任务解决器计算每个候选者对公共任务原型的偏好反事实收益,并通过预期每个任务家族的再利用来汇总. 我们在ActiveWebPref上评价了它,这是一个有控制的纵向基准,有隐藏但可查询的用户简介和精确的任务公用事业. 在20项任务中,34.4%的预算实际价值缺失偏好依赖摊销;APA获得80.3%,而当前任务的信息价值获得5.1%。 在与APA已实现支出相对应的每个用户问价上限下,APA的净效用高于四个热量选择基线。 在我们的成本设定中,询问每一个未知的偏好产生的净效用低于不询问的净效用,而APA则以27.6%的提问收回其84.2%的效用收益. 获得用户偏好的价值应考虑到它对未来任务的再利用,而不仅仅是它对当前任务的好处。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en:
Web agents can now carry out realistic Web tasks such as online shopping and navigating real-world websites ( Yao et al., 2022 ; Deng et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) , and they are moving from one-shot assistance to persistent service.
The same agent may book a user’s conference travel in March, order office supplies in April, and reserve a team dinner in May.
Its usefulness over time then depends less on any single task than on how well it knows the user : that the user avoids red-eye flights, keeps hotels under a per-night budget, and needs vegetarian options.
This paper studies that user-modeling problem for users of persistent Web agents: which missing preferences a persistent Web agent should acquire, and when doing so pays off.
blocks.zh:
现在Web代理可以进行现实的 网上购物和导航现实世界网站等网络任务(姚等,2022;邓等,2023;周等,2024等),从一发援助转向坚持服务.
同一代理人可在3月预订用户的会议旅行,在4月订购办公用品,在5月预订团队晚餐。
它的有用性随着时间推移,并不取决于任何单一的任务,而取决于它对用户的了解程度:用户避免红眼航班,将酒店维持在每晚的预算之下,并且需要素食选择。
本文研究了针对持续使用 网络代理商: 缺少一个持久偏好 网络代理商应当收购,并在这样做时得到回报.

blocks.en:
Valuable preferences, however, need not appear in the interaction history.
Personalization methods condition on past behavior ( Salemi et al., 2024 ) or infer profiles from what users have said ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , and long-term memory systems decide how to extract, store, retrieve, and update observed information ( Packer et al., 2023 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ; Chhikara et al., 2025 ; Rasmussen et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) .
These methods work with evidence that exists; a preference the user has never had reason to mention or to reveal through behavior cannot be extracted or retrieved.
blocks.zh:
然而,互动史上不必出现宝贵的偏好。
个性化方法以过去的行为为条件(Salemi等,2024年)或推断用户的描述(Zhang等,2026年),长期记忆系统决定如何取出,存储,取回并更新所观察的信息(Packer等,2023年;Zhong等,2024年;Chhikara等,2025年;Rasmussen等,2025年;Yang等,2026年).
这些方法与存在的证据相配合;用户从未有理由提及或通过行为披露的偏好是不能被提取或检索的.

blocks.en:
Asking can fill such gaps, but asking is not free: each question costs the user effort, and each answer discloses personal information.
An agent therefore cannot simply ask about everything; in our experiments, asking about every unknown preference, or about whatever an LLM deems most worth knowing, yields lower net utility than not asking at all (§ 6 ).
blocks.zh:
询问可以填补这些空白,但询问不是免费的:每个问题都花费用户的努力,每个答案都披露个人信息.
因此,代理人不能简单地询问所有情况;在我们实验中,询问每一个未知的偏好,或者任何LLM认为最值得了解的东西,其净效用比根本不问低(第6节)。

blocks.en:
Valuing each question by the current task does not resolve this either.
Current-task clarification and value-of-information (VoI) methods ask when a question improves the current task enough to justify its cost ( Rao and Daumé III, 2018 ; Aliannejadi et al., 2019 ; Zamani et al., 2020 ; Dong et al., 2026 ) .
While booking a hotel, the agent can finish without the user’s seat preference, so current-task VoI does not ask (Figure 1 ).
Why not wait and ask when a flight is booked?
Because even then, a single booking’s gain may not cover the cost of asking; only reuse across many later bookings does.
A criterion that values a question only by the task at hand then never acquires such a preference, however often it is reused (Proposition 3.1 ).
blocks.zh:
在当前任务中重视每个问题也不能解决这个问题。
当前任务澄清和信息价值方法(VoI)问,当一个问题改善当前任务,使其成本合理(Rao and Daumé III, 2018;Aliannejadi等, 2019;Zamani等, 2020;Dong等, 2026).
在预订酒店时,代理商可以在没有用户座位偏好的情况下完成,因此当前任务VoI不问(图1).
为什么不等一等,问飞机什么时候订好?
因为即便如此,单程预订的收益也可能无法支付询问的费用;只有在后来的许多预订中才能重复使用。
仅通过手头的任务来重视一个问题的标准,就永远不会获得这种偏好,尽管它经常被重新使用(建议3.1)。

blocks.en:
An agent therefore needs to value acquisition across tasks: Which currently unknown user preferences are worth acquiring, because their benefit across future tasks outweighs the cost of asking? We call this problem Active Preference Acquisition (APA).
At each interaction the agent holds a partial profile and can already complete the current task; it decides which missing preferences to ask about and stores the answers persistently.
Unlike cold-start elicitation or within-session clarification, APA interleaves acquisition with ongoing service and values persistent attributes by their reuse across heterogeneous future tasks.
We define the Prospective Personalization Value (PPV) of a missing preference: its expected utility gain across future tasks, minus the effort and disclosure-risk cost of asking.
PPV complements clarification rather than generalizing it, and the key distinction is in how a preference is valued, not when it is asked: a cross-task criterion may still ask at the first relevant task.
blocks.zh:
因此,一个代理人需要对各种任务的购置进行估价: 目前未知的用户偏好有哪些值得获得,因为它们在未来任务中的好处超过询问的成本? 我们将此问题称为积极优先购买。
在每次互动中,代理都持有一个部分的配置,并且已经可以完成当前的任务;它决定了哪些缺失的首选项可以不断询问和存储答案.
与冷起引出或会内澄清不同,APA将获取与持续服务相衔接,并且通过重复使用这些特性来价值持久性,使之涵盖各种不同的未来任务。
我们界定了一种缺失偏好的前景性个性化价值(PPV):它在未来任务中预期的效用收益,减去询问的努力和披露风险成本。
PPV是对澄清的补充,而不是概括,关键的区别在于如何评价偏好,而不是在问到时:跨任务标准在第一项相关任务时可能仍然会要求。

blocks.en:
We estimate PPV by counterfactual reuse valuation . For each candidate missing preference, the agent’s own task solver computes how much knowing it would change utility on public task prototypes, and these gains are aggregated by the expected reuse of each task family; questions are then selected under asking cost, disclosure risk and a per-interaction budget.
To test when this helps and by how much, we build ActiveWebPref, a controlled longitudinal testbed modeled on personalized Web services, with hidden but queryable user profiles, multi-domain task sequences, and exact task utilities. It isolates the value of preference acquisition, which existing memory benchmarks do not measure ( Wu et al., 2025a ; Maharana et al., 2024 ) , and does not evaluate agents acting on live websites.
blocks.zh:
我们通过反事实再利用估值估算PPV。 对于每一个缺少偏好的候选人,代理商自己的任务解决者计算出它知道它会在多大程度上改变对公共任务原型的效用,这些收益被每个任务家族的预期再利用相加;然后在询问成本、披露风险和每个互动预算时选择问题。
为了测试这帮助和多少,我们构建了ActiveWebPref,这是个人化的Web服务上一个可控的纵向测试床模型,有隐藏但可查询的用户配置,多域任务序列,以及精确的任务公用事业. 它隔离了获得优惠的价值,而现有的内存基准是无法衡量的(Wu等,2025a;Maharana等,2024),并且不评价在现场网站上行事的代理商.

blocks.en: Contributions. (1) Problem. We formulate Active Preference Acquisition and define PPV. We show that a criterion valuing only the current task never acquires a preference whose benefit on every single task is below the asking cost, however often it is reused, whereas PPV assigns it positive value once cumulative reuse covers that cost (Proposition 3.1 ). (2) Method. APA estimates PPV by counterfactual reuse valuation: the agent’s own task solver computes each candidate’s gain on public task prototypes, weighted by the expected reuse of each task family, and an adaptive greedy policy selects questions under asking cost, disclosure risk and a per-interaction budget (§ 4 ). (3) Benchmark. ActiveWebPref is a controlled longitudinal benchmark with 16 task families, hidden but queryable user profiles and exact task utilities, so the counterfactual value of an unasked preference can be measured; an initial-profile diagnostic identifies amortization-dependent preferences (§ 5 ). Code, data and prompts are available at https://github.com/xiaoqi-7/Active-Preference-Acquisition . (4) Findings. At a horizon of T = 20 T=20 tasks, 34.4% of budget-feasible valuable initially missing preferences are amortization-dependent; APA acquires 80.3% of them and Current-task VoI (public) 5.1%, while the NU-maximizing oracle acquires 44.9%, so the aim is selective rather than maximal acquisition. Among users with at least one such preference, APA improves whole-sequence net utility over Current-task VoI (public) at T = 20 T=20 (Holm p = 0.021 p=0.021 ) but not significantly at T = 10 T=10 . Under per-user asking-cost caps matched to APA’s realized expenditure, APA achieves higher net utility than random, frequency-based, impact-based and LLM-ranked selection (all Holm p ≤ 0.0025 p\leq 0.0025 ). In our cost setting, cost-blind asking yields lower net utility than not asking, while APA recovers 84.2% of exhaustive asking’s utility gain with 27.6% of its questions (§ 6 ).

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en:
Personalized systems condition generation or ranking on user profiles, given as explicit persona statements ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) or drawn from behavioral history ( Salemi et al., 2024 ) .
Recent LLM agents continuously infer and refine a unified user profile from dialogue turns ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , or update preference memories as user behavior evolves by fusing short- and long-term averages ( Sun et al., 2026 ) .
These methods infer preferences from evidence that already exists.
They cannot recover a preference that has never been expressed or revealed through behavior, and they do not decide which unobserved preferences are worth eliciting for future tasks.
blocks.zh:
个性化的系统条件生成或用户简介的排名,作为显性人物陈述(张等,2018年)或取自行为史(Salemi等,2024年).
近期LLM代理持续从对话转弯(张等,2026年)中推断并完善一个统一的用户配置,或随着用户行为的演化而更新偏好记忆,其方法是将短期和长期平均值(Sun等,2026年).
这些方法从已经存在的证据推断出偏好.
他们无法恢复从未通过行为表达或揭示的偏好,也不决定哪些未观察偏好值得为未来的任务而引出.

blocks.en:
Decision-theoretic preference elicitation frames question asking as a POMDP that trades question cost against the quality of a final decision ( Boutilier, 2002 ) .
Recommender systems ask new users to rate items in a cold-start interview ( Rashid et al., 2002 ) , possibly adapting the next item to earlier answers with a decision tree ( Golbandi et al., 2011 ) , and use active learning in collaborative filtering more broadly ( Elahi et al., 2016 ) .
Conversational recommenders decide within a session which item or attribute to ask about next ( Christakopoulou et al., 2016 ; Sun and Zhang, 2018 ; Lei et al., 2020a ; Lei et al., 2020b ; Deng et al., 2021 ; Jannach et al., 2021 ) .
LLMs have also been used to elicit preferences through open-ended questions: GATE prompts models to elicit a user’s intended task behavior ( Li et al., 2025 ) , and STaR-GATE fine-tunes a questioner to ask useful clarifying questions ( Andukuri et al., 2024 ) .
APA differs from this work in three ways.
(i) When and why to ask. Conversational elicitation asks in order to finish the current session. Cold-start interviews do ask for future benefit, but in a single onboarding step before any task is served. In APA, questions are interleaved with ongoing tasks that can already be completed, and each question is justified by its expected effect on future tasks.
(ii) Scope. Elicitation targets item ratings or attributes within a single catalog. APA acquires persistent user attributes that are reused across heterogeneous task families, such as flights, hotels, dining, and scheduling.
(iii) Valuation target. Like prior elicitation, APA weighs benefit against the cost of asking; the difference is that the benefit is counted across the heterogeneous future tasks that reuse the answer, rather than within one decision or session.
APA builds on established value-of-information and preference-elicitation principles ( Howard, 1966 ; Boutilier, 2002 ) , operationalizing them for persistent preferences reused across heterogeneous tasks, and adds a benchmark in which the counterfactual value of an unasked preference can be measured.

推荐系统要求新用户在一次冷启动访谈中评分项目(Rashid等,2002年),可能用一棵决策树(Golbandi等,2011年)对下一个项目进行调整以适应先前的答案,并在更广泛的协作过滤中使用积极学习(Elahi等,2016年)。
争相推荐者在会话中决定下一步要询问的项目或属性(Christakopoulou等,2016;Sun和Zhang等,2018;Lei等,2020a;Lei等,2020b;Deng等,2021;Jannach等,2021).
法学硕士也被用来通过开放式问题获得偏好: GATE促使模型引出用户的预期任务行为(Li等,2025年),STAR-GATE微调出一个提问者来提出有用的澄清问题(Andukuri等,2024年).
APA在三个方面与这项工作不同.
(一) 何时和为何要问。 要结束本届会议,需要商谈。 冷启动访谈确实要求获得未来的好处,但在完成任何任务之前采取一个入职步骤。 在《亚太行动计划》中,问题与已经可以完成的进行中的任务相互交织,每个问题因其对未来任务的预期影响而是合理的。
(二) 范围。 Eliaction针对单个目录中的项目评级或属性. APA具有持久性的用户属性,这些属性被重复用于各种不同的任务领域,例如飞行、旅馆、餐饮和时间安排。
(三) 估价目标。 与前引法一样,APA将利益与询问成本权衡;不同之处在于,利益被计入重复使用答案的未来任务,而不是在一项决定或会议中。
APA基于既定的信息价值和取消优惠原则(Howard,1966年;Boutillier,2002年),将这些原则用于不同任务中重复使用的持续优惠,并增加了一个基准,用以衡量未要求的优惠的反事实价值。

blocks.en:
Surveys organize agent memory by its sources, forms, and operations (writing, management, and reading) ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) .
Memory architectures give LLM agents persistent state through hierarchical context management ( Packer et al., 2023 ) , memory streams with reflection ( Park et al., 2023 ) , forgetting-aware stores ( Zhong et al., 2024 ) , scalable extraction and retrieval ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) , and temporal knowledge graphs ( Rasmussen et al., 2025 ) .
ProMem improves memory extraction itself: it extracts details, events, and relations separately, checks completeness to recover missed events, and verifies atomic facts ( Yang et al., 2026 ) .
Benchmarks such as LongMemEval ( Wu et al., 2025a ) and LoCoMo ( Maharana et al., 2024 ) test whether facts present in the history can be recalled.
PrefEval tests whether models follow stated or implicit preferences ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) , and PersonaMem whether they track preferences that evolve across sessions ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) ; both find that preferences already expressed are often not followed.
These systems answer how to retain and use what is known .
APA addresses which unknown information should be learned , and can run on top of any of them.

ProMem改进了内存提取本身:它分别取出细节,事件和关系,检查完整性以恢复错失的事件,并验证原子事实(Yang等,2026).
LongMemEval(Wu等,2025a)和LoCoMo(Maharana等,2024)等基准检验了历史中存在的事实是否可以被回忆.
PrefEval测试模型是否遵循声明的或隐含的偏好(Zhao等,2025年),以及PersonaMem是否跟踪跨会间演变的偏好(Jiang等,2025年;两者都发现已经表达的偏好往往没有遵循.
这些系统回答如何保留和使用已知的
APA 的地址是哪些未知信息应该得知,并且可以运行在其中任何一个之上.

blocks.en:
Asking clarifying questions has been studied in information retrieval ( Aliannejadi et al., 2019 ; Zamani et al., 2020 ) and in NLP, for example by ranking questions by expected value of perfect information ( Rao and Daumé III, 2018 ) .
For LLM agents, the IN3 benchmark annotates which details of a vague task are missing, and Mistral-Interact is trained to ask about them before executing ( Qian et al., 2024 ) , and Ask-before-Plan studies clarification before travel planning ( Zhang et al., 2024b ) .
Proactive Agent instead anticipates and offers help that the user has not requested ( Lu et al., 2025 ) .
Dong et al. ( Dong et al., 2026 ) formalize when an agent should ask rather than act by weighing the expected utility gain of a question on the current decision against the cost it imposes on the user.
Two lines of work look beyond the current response: one labels response preferences by simulating future conversation turns, teaching models when to ask clarifying questions ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) , and CollabLLM trains models with a multiturn-aware reward estimated from simulated future conversations ( Wu et al., 2025b ) .
Their horizon, however, is later turns of the same conversation, whereas the horizon of APA is future tasks across sessions.
Abstracting from these methods, current-task clarification scores a question about m m as V cur ​ ( m ) = Δ ​ U ​ ( τ t , m ) − C ⁡ ( m ) , V_{\text{cur}}(m)=\Delta U(\tau_{t};m)-C(m), whereas APA scores the same preference by its value over the tasks that follow, P ​ P ​ V T ​ ( m ) = 𝔼 ⁡ [ ∑ k = t + 1 T Δ ​ U ​ ( τ k , m ) ] − C ⁡ ( m ) . PPV_{T}(m)=\mathbb{E}\Big[\textstyle\sum_{k=t+1}^{T}\Delta U(\tau_{k};m)\Big]-C(m). The two scores answer different questions and are complementary.
Howard’s formulation values information for a single decision problem ( Howard, 1966 ) , and the non-myopic VoI of Krause and Guestrin ( Krause and Guestrin, 2005 ) selects a budget-constrained set of observations jointly, rather than greedily, to reduce uncertainty in one fixed model.
These principles can accommodate long-term benefit; APA instantiates them as a longitudinal personalization decision.
The information is stored, and it pays off across many future tasks drawn from an uncertain task distribution.

对于LLM代理商,IN3基准注释中缺少一个模糊任务的细节,Mistral-Interact经过培训后在执行前询问相关情况(Qian等,2024年),以及旅行规划前询问-计划前研究澄清(Zhang等,2024年b).

霍华德的配方对单个决策问题(Howard, 1966年)和克劳斯和Guestrin(Krause和Guestrin, 2005年)的非Myopic VoI都重视信息, 共同选择一套预算受限制的观察,而不是贪婪地在一个固定模式中减少不确定性。
这些原则可以照顾到长期利益;《反倾销法》将这些原则作为纵向个性化决定予以即时适用。

blocks.en:
Benchmarks for Web agents such as WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022 ) , Mind2Web ( Deng et al., 2023 ) , and WebArena ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) pose each episode as a single, self-contained instruction, with no user state carried across tasks.
Personalized Web agents have recently been studied through PersonalWAB, which pairs simulated users’ profiles and behavior histories with personalized search, recommendation, and review tasks and whose multi-turn track lets the agent clarify a request with a simulated user ( Cai et al., 2025 ) , and Persona2Web, which requires agents on the open Web to resolve ambiguous queries from long user histories ( Kim et al., 2026 ) .
Both personalize mainly from histories, and any questions serve the current request. Neither studies which missing preferences an agent should acquire for future tasks.

个人化 网络代理最近通过个人WAB(PersonalWAB)进行了研究,将模拟用户的概况和行为历史与个性化的搜索、推荐和审查任务联系起来,其多回转的跟踪让代理以模拟用户澄清一个请求(Cai等,2025年),Persona2Web(Persona2Web)则要求开放网络的代理解决来自长期用户历史(Kim等,2026年)的模棱两可的询问.

Overview of APA. ① Gap discovery proposes preferences 𝒢 t \mathcal{G}_{t} missing from the profile P t P_{t} . ② Future reuse modeling estimates how often each may be reused, from a coarse distribution over task families. ③ Prospective value estimation scores each by relevance and impact. ④ Cost-aware acquisition subtracts asking cost and disclosure risk and chooses Ask , Defer , or Skip . blocks.en: 4. The APA Framework

blocks.en:
APA estimates the terms of Eq. ( 1 ) with four modules (Figure 2 ). Its core is counterfactual reuse valuation (§ 4.3 ) combined with cost-sensitive budgeted selection (§ 4.4 ); gap discovery (§ 4.1 ) and future reuse modeling (§ 4.2 ) are implementation components that supply candidates and reuse estimates.
To isolate the acquisition decision, all LLM roles share the same backbone, and all policies share the same deterministic task solver.

blocks.en: 5. ActiveWebPref and Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 活动WebPref和实验设置

blocks.en:
Existing long-term memory benchmarks either place the information needed for each question in the history or ask models to abstain when it is absent ( Wu et al., 2025a ; Maharana et al., 2024 ) ; none rewards acquiring missing information.
APA instead requires preferences that are useful but initially absent from the history .
It also requires task utilities that can be computed exactly, so that the benefit of a question can be measured without an LLM judge.
We therefore build ActiveWebPref as a controlled longitudinal testbed.
The benchmarks discussed in § 2 do not directly provide a protocol with hidden but queryable profiles and counterfactual utilities of unasked preferences. ActiveWebPref is deliberately controlled so that the counterfactual utility of an unasked preference is known exactly, allowing us to measure whether each question was worth asking. This control comes at the cost of realism, which we discuss in § 8 .
blocks.zh:
现有的长期记忆基准要么将每个问题所需的信息放入历史,要么要求模型在没有信息时弃权(Wu等,2025a;Maharana等,2024;没有奖励获得缺失信息)。
相反,APA要求的偏好是有用的,但最初没有列入历史。
它还需要能够准确计算的任务设施,以便能够在没有LLM法官的情况下衡量问题的好处。
因此,我们把ActiveWebPref建成一个受控制的纵向试验台.
§2所讨论的基准并不直接提供含有隐藏但可查询的剖面图和反事实功能的未询问偏好的协议. ActiveWebPref被故意控制,这样就可以确切地知道一个未询问的偏好在反事实上的效用,从而使我们能够衡量每个问题是否值得问. 这种控制是以现实主义为代价的,我们在第8节中讨论了这一点。

blocks.en:
ActiveWebPref covers five service domains: Travel (flight booking, hotel selection, ground transport, conference trips), Dining (restaurant choice, reservation, takeaway), Shopping (product selection, gifts, repeat purchases), Scheduling (meetings, recurring events, appointments), and Work/Conference (conference, coordination, work events): 16 task families in total.
Task options are synthetic structured alternatives, rather than items taken from live Web catalogues.

blocks.en: Next-Task Only : public-belief value for the actual next task instance, without hidden answers; this is privileged lookahead.

blocks.en: Oracle Future-VoI : uses exact chronological subset dynamic programming to jointly optimize acquisitions and their timing, maximizing NU at the evaluation prices under the budget, with access to hidden answers and the actual future task sequence. blocks.en: 6.2. RQ2: What does current-task valuation miss?
blocks.zh: 6.2. RQ2:当前任务估值错过什么?

blocks.en:
Proposition 3.1 predicts a regime in which current-task valuation cannot acquire valuable preferences. We first ask whether this regime occurs at meaningful scale. We classify every (user, initially unknown, queryable, non-high-sensitivity attribute) pair in the test set by its per-task gains and weighted asking cost. Here g k | 0 fix ​ ( m ) = G q ​ ( m , τ k , P 0 ) g^{\mathrm{fix}}_{k\mid 0}(m)=G_{q}(m;\tau_{k},P_{0}) is the fixed-profile gain of Proposition 3.1 on saved future task τ k \tau_{k} , under the same public belief that Current-task VoI (public) uses and the initial visible profile P 0 P_{0} ; we write g k g_{k} for it below, and C = λ ​ c m + β ​ C risk ​ ( m ) C=\lambda c_{m}+\beta C_{\text{risk}}(m) with the evaluation prices λ = 0.5 \lambda=0.5 and β = 0.25 \beta=0.25 . We call this the initial-profile amortization diagnostic : because it uses fixed-profile gains at P 0 P_{0} rather than current gains along the trajectory, Proposition 3.1 does not guarantee that Current-task VoI (public) acquires none of these pairs, and we report its acquisition rate as an observation. Appendix A explains the observed acquisitions of diagnostic amortization-dependent attributes by Current-task VoI (public). The classes are single-use justified ( max k ⁡ g k ≥ C \max_{k}g_{k}\geq C ), amortization-dependent ( max k ⁡ g k < C \max_{k}g_{k}<C but ∑ k g k > C \sum_{k}g_{k}>C ), and not worth acquiring ( ∑ k g k ≤ C \sum_{k}g_{k}\leq C ). We call a pair a budget-feasible valuable missing preference if ∑ k g k > C \sum_{k}g_{k}>C and its asking cost fits the per-interaction budget, c m ≤ B c_{m}\leq B ; pairs with c m > B c_{m}>B cannot be asked by a budgeted policy and are excluded. Six attributes have c m > B c_{m}>B and are excluded; two of them would otherwise be amortization-dependent in 26 pairs at T = 20 T=20 .
At T = 20 T=20 and B = 0.5 B=0.5 , 198 pairs across 120 users (63 IID, 57 unseen) are amortization-dependent: 198/576, or 34.4 % 34.4\% , of budget-feasible valuable missing preferences. At T = 10 T=10 , the corresponding figures are 91 pairs across 71 users (36 IID, 35 unseen), 91/430 or 21.2 % 21.2\% ; 2 additional amortization-dependent pairs are excluded for exceeding B B .
Current-task VoI (public) acquires 10/198 ( 5.1 % 5.1\% ) of these pairs at T = 20 T=20 and 3/91 ( 3.3 % 3.3\% ) at T = 10 T=10 .
APA acquires 70.3 % 70.3\% (64/91) at T = 10 T=10 and 80.3 % 80.3\% (159/198) at T = 20 T=20 ; Oracle Future-VoI acquires 42.9 % 42.9\% (39/91) and 44.9 % 44.9\% (89/198), respectively (Table 3 ). The oracle optimizes joint net utility, rather than acquisition rate.
Oracle Future-VoI acquires none of these pairs before their first use (Table 3 ). Because its dynamic program breaks ties in favor of deferral (Appendix B ), this shows that an NU-optimal schedule within the oracle’s candidate pool never needs to acquire them earlier, not that waiting is strictly better; what separates it from Current-task VoI (public) is that it prices cross-task reuse, not that it asks earlier.
APA acquires more of these pairs than the oracle (80.3% versus 44.9% at T = 20 T=20 ) but realizes less attributed gain (0.307 versus 0.369), consistent with less precise selection or over-acquisition within this class, and with the modest rank agreement of its value estimates (Spearman 0.296 on this T = 20 T=20 cohort; Appendix F ). A higher acquisition rate is therefore not itself the goal: the NU-maximizing oracle acquires fewer than half of these preferences, so the task is to select those whose reuse repays their cost, and APA’s lower attributed gain leaves room for more precise selection. Attributed gain follows the actual order of questions: for each designated acquisition, it is the signed change in realized CTU on the arrived and remaining tasks when that answer is added to the answers obtained before it. It is gross of asking cost, summed over designated acquisitions, and averaged over all cohort users, with users who acquire none counted as zero; because it conditions on earlier answers, it differs from removing one attribute from the final profile.
Among users with at least one designated pair, APA’s improvement in whole-sequence NU over Current-task VoI (public) (paired mean differences 0.148 at T = 10 T=10 and 0.263 at T = 20 T=20 ) is significant at T = 20 T=20 (raw p = 0.010 p=0.010 , Holm p = 0.021 p=0.021 over the two horizons) but not at T = 10 T=10 ( p = 0.074 p=0.074 ) (Tables 4 and 9 ). The tests pair the same 120 users at T = 20 T=20 and 71 at T = 10 T=10 , each with at least one feasible amortization-dependent pair; they use 2,000 two-sided centered user-bootstrap resamples with a plus-one correction. Holm correction covers these two NU contrasts, not attribute pairs or the attributed gains in Table 3 . These results support an advantage for these users, but do not attribute the whole gain to the designated attributes.
Under the initial profile, preferences that need cumulative reuse to cover their asking cost thus make up a substantial share of valuable missing preferences; Current-task VoI (public) rarely acquires them, and the resulting advantage of cross-task valuation appears at the longer horizon.

blocks.en: 8. Limitations and Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 8. 限制和道德考虑

blocks.en:
ActiveWebPref uses synthetic profiles and a simulated user, which makes exact utilities and controlled ablations possible but cannot fully reflect real user behavior.
Real users may answer vaguely, change their minds, or find questions annoying in ways that our cost model only approximates; the validity requirements and limitations of LLM-based user simulators are discussed in ( Balog and Zhai, 2025 ) .
No completed blinded human evaluation, paraphrase/noise robustness study, or live-Web deployment is reported. The deterministic simulator binds structured attribute IDs to text; this does not validate how a real user understands a generated question.
blocks.zh:
ActiveWebPref使用合成剖面图和一个模拟用户,这使得精确的公用设施和控制活化成为可能,但不能充分反映真正的用户行为.
真实用户可能回答模糊,改变主意,或发现问题令人烦恼,而我们的成本模型仅大致如此;基于LLM的用户模拟器的有效性要求和限制在(Balog and Zhai, 2025.)中被讨论.
没有关于已完成的盲目人类评价、口音/噪音强性研究或现场网络部署的报告。 决定性的模拟器将结构化的属性ID绑定在文本上;这并不能验证一个真正的用户如何理解所生成的问题.

blocks.en: All LLM roles use Qwen3-8B, and all results come from one controlled benchmark; whether the findings hold with stronger backbones, other solvers, or other task distributions remains to be tested. APA also relies on a public schema for each task family to generate prototypes, so extending it to unseen task families would require inferring such schemas, for example with the LLM backbone.

blocks.en:
An agent that asks questions proactively could be misused to collect more personal data than needed.
LLMs and LLM agents already leak private information in contexts where disclosure is inappropriate ( Mireshghallah et al., 2024 ; Shao et al., 2024 ) , and data minimization, giving an agent access only to the data a task needs, has been proposed as a defense ( Bagdasarian et al., 2024 ) .
APA is designed to limit such over-collection.
Its goal is selective acquisition, not maximal profile completion.
Privacy risk is a modeled cost term, not a calibrated privacy guarantee. The simulator refuses all high-sensitivity requests and charges asking cost even on refusal. Practical policies can still attempt intrusive questions before learning a refusal; the implemented rule does not enforce an exception for task-required sensitive disclosure.
In deployment, acquired attributes should be visible to users, editable, and deletable, and asking should require consent.
All data in ActiveWebPref is synthetic and contains no real personal information.

blocks.en: 9. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9. 国家 结论

blocks.en:
The passive personalization and memory methods discussed here use only the preferences that users happen to reveal.
We argued that long-term Web agents should selectively acquire missing user information when expected reuse justifies its cost.
We formalized this as Active Preference Acquisition, defined Prospective Personalization Value over future tasks as a complement to current-task clarification, and characterized an amortization regime that current-task valuation systematically misses because no single use justifies the cost of asking.
In controlled long-term personalization tasks, our experiments support the reuse-based motivation: at T = 20 T=20 , amortization-dependent preferences make up 34.4% of budget-feasible valuable initially missing preferences, and APA acquires 80.3% of them while Current-task VoI (public) acquires 10 of 198; under matched asking-cost caps, APA selects better questions than heuristic baselines; cross-task, cost-aware acquisition recovers most of exhaustive asking’s utility gain with far fewer questions, and its mean advantage is larger at T = 20 T=20 than at T = 1 T=1 . Future work should test the effect under richer task distributions and with real users.
A personalized agent should learn not everything about a user, but the things whose reuse makes them worth asking about.

The oracle solves a dynamic program over T + 1 T+1 decision nodes: the pre-sequence opportunity, which yields no utility, and the arrival of each task; the value after the last node is zero. The state is the node and the set M M of attributes acquired so far; an action asks any subset S S of unacquired attributes with ∑ m ∈ S c m ≤ B \sum_{m\in S}c_{m}\leq B . Because the budget resets at every node, no remaining-budget dimension is needed. Values use hidden answers, the actual future tasks, the shared solver and NU at the evaluation prices. Candidates exclude known, non-queryable and high-sensitivity attributes, attributes with c m > B c_{m}>B , and attributes no task in the sequence uses, leaving 4–12 attributes per user at B = 0.5 B=0.5 . blocks.en: Using all visible information, including history, memory, and the current_task being faced, explicitly predict the relative likelihoods of future task families that have not yet arrived, rather than specific events. Do not output distribution, candidate importance, or attribute values.
